source: The owner's words typed in one working session on 2026-11-24, in the desktop app, after the book interface (Stages 1000–1140) was merged and deployed. This record is written by the same session: it saw every word below typed.
theBrief: Задача - доработать проект чтобы весь интервейс проекта был в стиле книги. Другая сессия сделала большой кусок работы. Тебе необходимо доработать до конца задуманное, выявить неудобства использования и предложить улучшения. Для ассетов верстки и картинок в твоем распоряжении Codex CLI. Текущий вид меня не сильно впечатляет и кажется что не все функции достаточно очевидны и интуитивно доступны для использования. Жду от тебя предложений. Можешь обратиться к Codex CLI для генерации нескольких идей.

whatTheSessionTookFromIt.toDo: Finish what the book program meant and left: the book's shell as a thing, the room a page gives its words, defects a reader meets. No product choice is needed for these (work-orders/BOOK_POLISH_2026-11-24.md).
whatTheSessionTookFromIt.toFindOut: Where the product is inconvenient: read from the running product, as a DM on a tablet and a laptop, a player on a phone, the table's screen, the shelf and the workshop.
whatTheSessionTookFromIt.toPropose: How the books should look and work from here. Proposals only: nothing of them is built until the owner chooses.

shownToTheOwner.page: A private page «Второй проход книги» (https://claude.ai/artifact/7i7fSfLqy8kCsHqihKUBAL): the findings with screenshots, before and after of what this session changed, seven concept pictures, the steps proposed and four questions.
shownToTheOwner.conceptPictures: Seven pictures by Codex CLI in the lighthouse's style, from today's screenshots: the DM's spread in three directions (a real book, the book on the table, an illuminated page), a fight as a fold-out map, the open book on the table's screen, the shelf, a player's phone. Originals and prompts: ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/book-polish-2026-11-24/.
shownToTheOwner.independentReading: Codex CLI was also asked for a critique of eleven screenshots without the session's conclusions (the same folder, ideas/ideas.md); it is summarised on the page.

picturesAndText.pictures: The concept pictures are ideas, shown to the owner only; none is shipped. No book material of the product changed.
picturesAndText.text: One phrase of the interface is new and written by the session, for the owner to read: the example in "Add to the world" — «Например: свидетель у входа, который видел, кто ушёл ночью.» (it replaced Ravenford's caravan, shown in every campaign). No model wrote text for the product.

answersInTheQuestionCard.question: Какое направление вида берём для книг? Картинки А, Б и В — на странице «Второй проход книги» и в файлах выше.
answersInTheQuestionCard.meaning: The open volume edge to edge with a thin frame: page edges, a spine, a ribbon, the DM's actions as seals. Typography (an initial, notes in the margin) from direction В.

answersInTheQuestionCard.question: Как устроить главный экран мастера? Сейчас «Книга» — чтобы читать, «Сцена» — чтобы видеть, кто здесь, и между ними приходится ходить.
answersInTheQuestionCard.meaning: The Scene becomes the spread the game is run from: the story of the page the party is at, who is here, the seals «Бросок», «Бой», «Привал», «На экран», «Выдать». The Book stays as the contents and for reading ahead.

answersInTheQuestionCard.question: Что делать первым после уже сделанной правки оболочки?
answersInTheQuestionCard.meaning: The DM's working spread is the next piece of work.

answersInTheQuestionCard.question: Что сделать с уже готовой правкой оболочки (ветка claude/book-interface-polish: одна шапка, 10 строк вместо 5,5, закладки со словами)?
answersInTheQuestionCard.meaning: The shell work goes to a pull request; merging and deployment only on his word.

authorized: The shell work of work-orders/BOOK_POLISH_2026-11-24.md, as the brief's «доработать до конца задуманное», and its pull request.
The DM's working spread (Stage 1150; its work order comes with its pull request), in direction А, as the first piece after the shell.
notAuthorized: The other proposals of the page (the fight as one fold-out, the Party's and the Table's pages by tasks, the table's screen, the shelf, a player's phone, new book materials for every campaign): each waits for the owner's word.
standingOwnerRulesThisWorkKeeps: 2026-11-19: the product «looks like an Excel table»; the next step obvious, not a search line.
2026-11-20: no rails — «DnD — это про свободу выбора и действий».
2026-11-21: sections full screen with a way to close, everything at hand, the least scrolling; every main DM task has a visible entry named with his own word.
2026-11-21: «Читать всё самому» — every phrase a model wrote is read by the owner before it reaches a table.
2026-11-23: each book has its own style from its campaign's art; book materials by Codex CLI.
unchangedBoundaries: The World Engine alone changes the world; no command, route, contract or rule changed.
Knowledge isolation: a player's client and the table's screen receive only their own projections.
No AI at the table; no paid provider call.
Nothing is merged or deployed by the session without the owner's word.
